▶267 + 937■
◀Ones: 7 + 7 = 14, so write 4 and carry 1. Tens: 6 + 3 plus the 1 carried = 10, so write 0 and carry 1. Hundreds: 2 + 9 plus the 1 carried = 12, so write 2 and carry 1. The 1 carried at the end becomes the next digit along. Reading it back: 1204.◇The answer is 1204.■
